author: Aether II
title: AER-6.0: Refactored Two Conv1D Layers Baseline (Mean Pooling)
abstract: Establishment of a refactored 'Two Conv1D Layers Baseline' with explicit task-specific prediction heads, while maintaining the architectural and hyperparameter configuration of AER-5.7. This serves as a clean, modular foundation for subsequent experiments on Regression Calibration and Adaptive Pooling, ensuring a controlled environment for testing new ideas.

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
import optax
from typing import Any, Dict, Sequence

# --- Prediction Head Modules ---
# These are now standalone and configurable
class RegressionHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float
    l2_norm_input: bool = False # Parameter for RegCal L2 norm

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        if self.l2_norm_input:
            norm = jnp.linalg.norm(x, ord=2, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
            x = x / (norm + 1e-6) # Add epsilon for stability

        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits.squeeze(-1)

class MultiLabelRegressionHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

class MultiLabelClassificationHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

class MultiClassClassificationHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

# --- Backbone Architecture ---
class TwoConvBackbone(nn.Module):
    hidden_dim: int
    conv_features: int
    conv_kernel_size: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)
        
        # First Conv1D layer
        x = nn.Conv(
            features=self.conv_features,
            kernel_size=(self.conv_kernel_size,),
            padding='SAME',
            name='conv1d_layer_1'
        )(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Second Conv1D layer
        x = nn.Conv(
            features=self.conv_features,
            kernel_size=(self.conv_kernel_size,),
            padding='SAME',
            name='conv1d_layer_2'
        )(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        
        # MLP layer after convolutions, before pooling
        x = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim, name='backbone_dense')(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        
        return x # Output: (batch, seq_len, hidden_dim)

# --- Top-level Network with Multi-Head Logic and Pooling ---
class TwoConvMultiHeadNetwork(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any] # Pass all hparams here to configure sub-modules

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # 1. Feature Extraction Backbone
        backbone_features = TwoConvBackbone(
            hidden_dim=self.hparams['hidden_dim'],
            conv_features=self.hparams['conv_features'],
            conv_kernel_size=self.hparams['conv_kernel_size'],
            dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'],
            name='two_conv_backbone'
        )(x, deterministic=deterministic) # Output: (batch, seq_len, hidden_dim)

        # 2. Global Pooling (Mean Pooling for AER-6.0)
        # In AER-6.0, use_adaptive_pooling is False
        pooled_features = jnp.mean(backbone_features, axis=1) # Output: (batch, hidden_dim)

        # 3. Task-Specific Prediction Head
        d_output = self.hparams['d_output'] # From dataset config
        task_type = self.hparams['task_type'] # From dataset config
        
        # All heads use the global dropout_rate for AER-6.0
        head_dropout = self.hparams['dropout_rate'] 
        use_l2_norm = False # No RegCal L2 for AER-6.0

        if task_type == "regression":
            logits = RegressionHead(
                d_output=d_output,
                dense_dim=self.hparams['head_dense_dim'],
                dropout_rate=head_dropout,
                l2_norm_input=use_l2_norm,
                name='regression_head'
            )(pooled_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif task_type == "multilabel_regression":
            logits = MultiLabelRegressionHead(
                d_output=d_output,
                dense_dim=self.hparams['head_dense_dim'],
                dropout_rate=head_dropout,
                name='multilabel_regression_head'
            )(pooled_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif task_type == "multilabel_classification":
            logits = MultiLabelClassificationHead(
                d_output=d_output,
                dense_dim=self.hparams['head_dense_dim'],
                dropout_rate=head_dropout,
                name='multilabel_classification_head'
            )(pooled_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif task_type == "multiclass_classification":
            logits = MultiClassClassificationHead(
                d_output=d_output,
                dense_dim=self.hparams['head_dense_dim'],
                dropout_rate=head_dropout,
                name='multiclass_classification_head'
            )(pooled_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown task type: {task_type}")

        return logits

# --- Network Wrapper for Flax interface ---
class TwoConvNetworkWrapper:
    def __init__(self, model_instance, all_hparams):
        self.network = model_instance
        self.all_hparams = all_hparams # Store all hparams for the apply method

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, self.all_hparams, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, self.all_hparams, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0) 
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, self.all_hparams, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

# --- Hyperparameter Definition ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'hidden_dim': 512, # Final dense layer size in backbone
        'conv_features': 256, # Feature depth for Conv1D layers
        'conv_kernel_size': 5,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1, # Global dropout rate (used for backbone and non-reg heads)
        'head_dense_dim': 128, # Intermediate dense layer size for all prediction heads

        # RegCal specific hparams (set to False/default for AER-6.0)
        'use_regcal_l2': False, 
        'reg_head_dropout_rate': 0.1, 

        # Adaptive Pooling specific hparams (set to False for AER-6.0)
        'use_adaptive_pooling': False,
        'pooling_gate_dense_dim': 64, 
    }

# --- Network Creation Function ---
def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    # Combine global hparams with dataset-specific ones
    # The main network expects a single hparams dict
    all_hparams = _define_hyperparameters()
    all_hparams.update(hparams) # Dataset-specific overrides (d_output, task_type, etc.)

    model = TwoConvMultiHeadNetwork(hparams=all_hparams)
    return TwoConvNetworkWrapper(model, all_hparams) # Pass all_hparams to wrapper for init/apply

# --- Optimizer Creation (Same as before) ---
def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=0.01)
    )

BASE_SEED = 42 # Using a fixed seed for baseline verification
BATCH_SIZE = 64

# Debug Report for Evaluation 790

## Summary
**SUCCESS** - Fixed the code on first attempt. The submission now runs successfully and achieved a score of **0.5196** (average across 7 RNA datasets).

## Root Cause
The original code had a **Flax/JAX API misuse** in the `TwoConvNetworkWrapper` class. The wrapper was incorrectly passing `self.all_hparams` as a positional argument when calling the Flax module's `init()` and `apply()` methods.

**Specific error:**
```
TypeError: TwoConvMultiHeadNetwork.__call__() got multiple values for argument 'deterministic'
```

**Root cause analysis:**
The `TwoConvMultiHeadNetwork` class defines `hparams` as a **class attribute** (Flax module attribute):
```python
class TwoConvMultiHeadNetwork(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any]  # This is a MODULE ATTRIBUTE, not a call parameter

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # ...
```

However, the wrapper was treating it as if it were a call-time parameter:
```python
# WRONG - passes all_hparams as positional argument
variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                             dummy_input, self.all_hparams, deterministic=True)
```

This caused `self.all_hparams` to be interpreted as a positional argument, which then conflicted with the `deterministic=True` keyword argument, resulting in the "multiple values for argument" error.

## Fix Applied
Modified the `TwoConvNetworkWrapper.init()` and `TwoConvNetworkWrapper.apply()` methods to remove the erroneous `self.all_hparams` argument:

**In `init()` method (line 172-175):**
```python
# Before:
variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                             dummy_input, self.all_hparams, deterministic=True)

# After:
variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                             dummy_input, deterministic=True)
```

**In `apply()` method (line 177-188):**
```python
# Before (deterministic=True case):
return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, self.all_hparams, deterministic=True)

# After:
return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)

# Before (deterministic=False case):
return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, self.all_hparams, deterministic=False,
                        rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

# After:
return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                        rngs={'dropout': rng_key})
```

The `hparams` were already passed to the network during initialization (`model = TwoConvMultiHeadNetwork(hparams=all_hparams)`), so they don't need to be passed again during `init()` or `apply()` calls.

## Results
The fixed code (submission_v2.py) successfully completed training on all 7 RNA datasets:

| Dataset | Metric | Score |
|---------|--------|-------|
| APA | R2 | 0.6803 |
| CRI-Off | Spearman | 0.0400 |
| Modif | AUC-ROC | 0.7179 |
| CRI-On | Spearman | 0.4289 |
| PRS | R2 | 0.4545 |
| MRL | R2 | 0.6219 |
| ncRNA | Accuracy | 0.6938 |

**Overall Score:** 0.5196

## Technical Notes
This was a straightforward API misuse bug rather than a logical or algorithmic error. The network architecture itself was sound - it just needed the wrapper to call Flax methods correctly. Flax modules store their configuration as class attributes, and these are accessed internally during forward passes without needing to be passed as call-time arguments.

## Summary
**SUCCESS** - Fixed the code on first attempt. The submission now runs successfully and achieved a score of **0.5196** (average across 7 RNA datasets).

## Root Cause
The original code had a **Flax/JAX API misuse** in the `TwoConvNetworkWrapper` class. The wrapper was incorrectly passing `self.all_hparams` as a positional argument when calling the Flax module's `init()` and `apply()` methods.

**Specific error:**
```
TypeError: TwoConvMultiHeadNetwork.__call__() got multiple values for argument 'deterministic'
```

**Root cause analysis:**
The `TwoConvMultiHeadNetwork` class defines `hparams` as a **class attribute** (Flax module attribute):
```python
class TwoConvMultiHeadNetwork(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any]  # This is a MODULE ATTRIBUTE, not a call parameter

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # ...
```

However, the wrapper was treating it as if it were a call-time parameter:
```python
# WRONG - passes all_hparams as positional argument
variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                             dummy_input, self.all_hparams, deterministic=True)
```

This caused `self.all_hparams` to be interpreted as a positional argument, which then conflicted with the `deterministic=True` keyword argument, resulting in the "multiple values for argument" error.

## Fix Applied
Modified the `TwoConvNetworkWrapper.init()` and `TwoConvNetworkWrapper.apply()` methods to remove the erroneous `self.all_hparams` argument:

**In `init()` method (line 172-175):**
```python
# Before:
variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                             dummy_input, self.all_hparams, deterministic=True)

# After:
variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                             dummy_input, deterministic=True)
```

**In `apply()` method (line 177-188):**
```python
# Before (deterministic=True case):
return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, self.all_hparams, deterministic=True)

# After:
return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)

# Before (deterministic=False case):
return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, self.all_hparams, deterministic=False,
                        rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

# After:
return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                        rngs={'dropout': rng_key})
```

The `hparams` were already passed to the network during initialization (`model = TwoConvMultiHeadNetwork(hparams=all_hparams)`), so they don't need to be passed again during `init()` or `apply()` calls.

Flax modules store their configuration as class attributes, and these are accessed internally during forward passes without needing to be passed as call-time arguments.

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
import optax
from typing import Any, Dict, Sequence

# --- Prediction Head Modules ---
# These are now standalone and configurable
class RegressionHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float
    l2_norm_input: bool = False # Parameter for RegCal L2 norm

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        if self.l2_norm_input:
            norm = jnp.linalg.norm(x, ord=2, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
            x = x / (norm + 1e-6) # Add epsilon for stability

        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits.squeeze(-1)

class MultiLabelRegressionHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

class MultiLabelClassificationHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

class MultiClassClassificationHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

# --- Backbone Architecture ---
class TwoConvBackbone(nn.Module):
    hidden_dim: int
    conv_features: int
    conv_kernel_size: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)

        # First Conv1D layer
        x = nn.Conv(
            features=self.conv_features,
            kernel_size=(self.conv_kernel_size,),
            padding='SAME',
            name='conv1d_layer_1'
        )(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Second Conv1D layer
        x = nn.Conv(
            features=self.conv_features,
            kernel_size=(self.conv_kernel_size,),
            padding='SAME',
            name='conv1d_layer_2'
        )(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # MLP layer after convolutions, before pooling
        x = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim, name='backbone_dense')(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        return x # Output: (batch, seq_len, hidden_dim)

# --- Top-level Network with Multi-Head Logic and Pooling ---
class TwoConvMultiHeadNetwork(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any] # Pass all hparams here to configure sub-modules

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # 1. Feature Extraction Backbone
        backbone_features = TwoConvBackbone(
            hidden_dim=self.hparams['hidden_dim'],
            conv_features=self.hparams['conv_features'],
            conv_kernel_size=self.hparams['conv_kernel_size'],
            dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'],
            name='two_conv_backbone'
        )(x, deterministic=deterministic) # Output: (batch, seq_len, hidden_dim)

        # 2. Global Pooling (Mean Pooling for AER-6.0)
        # In AER-6.0, use_adaptive_pooling is False
        pooled_features = jnp.mean(backbone_features, axis=1) # Output: (batch, hidden_dim)

        # 3. Task-Specific Prediction Head
        d_output = self.hparams['d_output'] # From dataset config
        task_type = self.hparams['task_type'] # From dataset config

        # All heads use the global dropout_rate for AER-6.0
        head_dropout = self.hparams['dropout_rate']
        use_l2_norm = False # No RegCal L2 for AER-6.0

        if task_type == "regression":
            logits = RegressionHead(
                d_output=d_output,
                dense_dim=self.hparams['head_dense_dim'],
                dropout_rate=head_dropout,
                l2_norm_input=use_l2_norm,
                name='regression_head'
            )(pooled_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif task_type == "multilabel_regression":
            logits = MultiLabelRegressionHead(
                d_output=d_output,
                dense_dim=self.hparams['head_dense_dim'],
                dropout_rate=head_dropout,
                name='multilabel_regression_head'
            )(pooled_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif task_type == "multilabel_classification":
            logits = MultiLabelClassificationHead(
                d_output=d_output,
                dense_dim=self.hparams['head_dense_dim'],
                dropout_rate=head_dropout,
                name='multilabel_classification_head'
            )(pooled_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif task_type == "multiclass_classification":
            logits = MultiClassClassificationHead(
                d_output=d_output,
                dense_dim=self.hparams['head_dense_dim'],
                dropout_rate=head_dropout,
                name='multiclass_classification_head'
            )(pooled_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown task type: {task_type}")

        return logits

# --- Network Wrapper for Flax interface ---
class TwoConvNetworkWrapper:
    def __init__(self, model_instance, all_hparams):
        self.network = model_instance
        self.all_hparams = all_hparams # Store all hparams for the apply method

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        # FIXED: Don't pass all_hparams as argument - it's a class attribute of the network
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            # FIXED: Don't pass all_hparams as argument
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
            # FIXED: Don't pass all_hparams as argument
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

# --- Hyperparameter Definition ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'hidden_dim': 512, # Final dense layer size in backbone
        'conv_features': 256, # Feature depth for Conv1D layers
        'conv_kernel_size': 5,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1, # Global dropout rate (used for backbone and non-reg heads)
        'head_dense_dim': 128, # Intermediate dense layer size for all prediction heads

        # RegCal specific hparams (set to False/default for AER-6.0)
        'use_regcal_l2': False,
        'reg_head_dropout_rate': 0.1,

        # Adaptive Pooling specific hparams (set to False for AER-6.0)
        'use_adaptive_pooling': False,
        'pooling_gate_dense_dim': 64,
    }

# --- Network Creation Function ---
def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    # Combine global hparams with dataset-specific ones
    # The main network expects a single hparams dict
    all_hparams = _define_hyperparameters()
    all_hparams.update(hparams) # Dataset-specific overrides (d_output, task_type, etc.)

    model = TwoConvMultiHeadNetwork(hparams=all_hparams)
    return TwoConvNetworkWrapper(model, all_hparams) # Pass all_hparams to wrapper for init/apply

# --- Optimizer Creation (Same as before) ---
def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=0.01)
    )

BASE_SEED = 42 # Using a fixed seed for baseline verification
BATCH_SIZE = 64
